coverage: 53 exact static exports and 10 dynamic photo slots. Fresh contexts cover eleven desktop and eleven mobile sections. slotVerification: Runtime hashes are checked by verify.mjs. Hero seals preserve individual intrinsic SVG layers and Figma letter positions. Recognition artwork is 150x132. Circular text-path node 15888:6643 was recovered through read-only use_figma; its vector geometry and typography are preserved with dynamic application text. Centre illustration is specific to the sample Chennai locations and is not shown for unrelated live addresses.
